(i) exposure in utero to an extreme natural disaster (Ice Storm of 1998 in Canada) is related to cognitive and language development in the offspring; (ii) the timing of the exposure during pregnancy is a critical moderator; (iii) the effects of the exposure are independent of the effects of postnatal stressors and maternal anxiety.
